title: Seeding 90mm NGM Plates with Bacteria
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5xkg7kw

steps.title: Transfer bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Transfer the bacterial culture to a 50 ml Falcon tube using a serological pipette and a pipetboy at the Bunsen burner to allow the repeat combitip pipetter to reach the culture.

steps.title: Prepare repeat pipetter
steps.instruction: Set the repeat pipetter to dispense 600 ul at each push and aspire 10 ml of bacterial culture into a combitip.

substeps.instruction: Set repeat pipetter to 600 ul per push
Aspire 10 ml of bacterial culture into a combitip

steps.title: Seed NGM plates
steps.instruction: Dispense 600 ul of bacterial culture as a blob onto each 9 cm NGM plate.

steps.title: Dry plates
steps.instruction: Leave the plates to dry at room temperature for one or two days with the lids closed and away from the Bunsen burner.
